source: placeholders (rules only; Phase 0 writes research/universe.json and reruns this script)

exclusions.rule: base asset BTC or ETH, and any base starting with BTC or ETH (BTCDOM, ETHW, ETHFI, …), removed before any ranking; never in a tier, this manifest or a config

admission.allTiers: median trades/min over the last 30 complete UTC days ≥ 10
admission.hygiene: present/requested ≥ 0.95, suspect ≤ 2 % of present, blacklisted minutes ≤ 3 % of span, no ≥ 7-day hole (research-plan.md §A.6)
admission.venueFeasibility: dry-run planned days ≥ 95 % of requested and no run of ≥ 7 unavailable days

tiers.T1: majors: BNBUSDT, XRPUSDT, SOLUSDT plus the next two by 30-day median quote-volume rank (BTC/ETH removed)
tiers.T2: large liquid alts: volume ranks 6–25, five symbols at VolUnit-bps quantile positions {min, p25, p50, p75, max}
tiers.T3: mid-caps: volume ranks 26–75, same quantile pick
tiers.T4: low-cap / high-VolUnit: volume ranks 76–200 ∧ tpm ≥ 10, top five by VolUnit bps; T4#1 becomes data.lowCapSymbol
tiers.T5: recent listings: listing age ∈ [250, 410) days ∧ tpm ≥ 10, top four by quote volume; span = listing + 15 d → 2026-09-18
tiers.T6: coarse tick: tick/price ≥ 1 bp, top two by quote volume; may duplicate T1–T4 (labelled, not double-counted in the budget)

assumptions.replacedBy: Phase 0 step P0.6 (dry-run day counts) and P0.7 (du -sh after the Binance fetch)

trimRule: if the Phase-0 projection of all admitted triples exceeds 350 GB: drop venues for T3–T6 in the order kucoin, bitget, gate, okx until ≤ 350 GB; T1–T2 keep all six venues
